spells.name: Galeforce
spells.body: As a **Full Action** conjure heavy winds around you, choosing a cardinal direction (North, East, South and West) for those winds to flow against. With a **6m** radius AoE of you, enemies moving straight or diagonally towards the chosen direction treats their movement as **Difficult Terrain**. Radius increases by **+2m** per 20 Wind CA. Galeforce moves with you and reaches all heights within the AoE.

upgrades.text: Instead of Galeforce centering around you, choose a point within **6m** as its origin. It cannot move from this point.
Allies gain **3m** of *Free Movement* that can only be used when moving straight or diagonally **opposite** of the chosen direction. Movement increases by **+1m** per 20 Wind CA.
